OpenTracker changes to the vendored PJRC Teensy 3.x core (upstream commit in
UPSTREAM_COMMIT). Everything else in this directory is unmodified.

1. usb_desc.h, USB_MIDI_SERIAL section: when OT_USB_VID and OT_USB_PID are
   defined (reimpl/Makefile passes them), use that VID/PID and the strings
   "OpenTracker" / "OpenTracker" instead of PJRC's 0x16C0/0x0489
   "Teensyduino" / "Teensy MIDI" (PJRC's IDs are licensed for genuine Teensy
   boards only). Marked "OPENTRACKER PATCH". Without the -D flags the file
   behaves exactly like upstream.
   Current IDs: 0x1209/0x0001 = pid.codes test PID. TODO: register a real
   pid.codes PID before any public release.

2. USB mass storage (OpenTracker 2.x USB Storage mode), all marked
   "OPENTRACKER PATCH" and active only with -DOT_USB_MSC=1 (reimpl/Makefile
   default; OT_USB_MSC=0 or undefined compiles exactly the upstream MIDI +
   Serial device):
   - usb_desc.h, USB_MIDI_SERIAL section: NUM_ENDPOINTS 7, NUM_INTERFACE 4,
     MSC_INTERFACE 3 with bulk IN endpoint 6 and bulk OUT endpoint 7 (64 B).
   - usb_desc.c: the mass-storage interface descriptor (class 08h, subclass
     06h SCSI transparent, protocol 50h Bulk-Only) after all other interfaces;
     OT_USB_DESC_HOST_TEST leaves out usb_init_serialnumber() so the host
     descriptor check (reimpl/tests/usb_desc_test.cpp) can compile the file,
     and replaces the weak aliases of the usb_string_* names with #defines
     of the *_default strings (Mach-O, the macOS host format, has no aliases).
   - usb_dev.c: a bulk endpoint driver for the two MSC endpoints (packets go by
     DMA straight into / out of caller segments; explicit DATA0/1 tracking,
     reset to DATA0 on SET_CONFIGURATION and CLEAR_FEATURE(ENDPOINT_HALT)),
     the Bulk-Only class requests (Mass Storage Reset, Get Max LUN), and hooks
     in SET_CONFIGURATION, CLEAR_FEATURE, usb_rx_memory(), the token, SOF and
     bus-reset paths of usb_isr() so the generic packet code never touches the
     MSC endpoints.
   - usb_desc.c, usb_init_serialnumber(): with the MSC interface the serial
     number string is 20 hex digits from the chip's unique ID (SIM_UIDMH
     low 16 bits, SIM_UIDML, SIM_UIDL; the factory serial in hex if the UID
     reads as zero), since Windows' USBSTOR ignores serials shorter than 12
     hex characters. Without it the upstream 10-digit decimal serial.
   - usb_msc.h (new, OpenTracker's own, same permissive terms as this
     directory): the interface of that driver; usb_msc_impl.h (new, same
     terms): the driver itself, included by usb_dev.c inside its
     MSC_INTERFACE block and by the host test
     reimpl/tests/usb_msc_driver_test.cpp against a simulated controller. The protocol layer is
     reimpl/src/core/usb/msc_bot.* (OpenTracker).
